import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date


@dataclass
class Hire:
    id: int
    customer: int
    due: date


def open_db(path):
    db = sqlite3.connect(path)
    db.execute("create table if not exists customers(id integer primary key, member integer)")
    return db


def is_member(db, customer):
    row = db.execute("select member from customers where id = ?", (customer,)).fetchone()
    return bool(row and row[0])


# flowguard: sensor MAY_BORROW fields days=(today - hire.due).days member=is_member(db, hire.customer)
def may_borrow(db: sqlite3.Connection, hire: Hire, today: date) -> bool:
    if (today - hire.due).days <= 10:
        return True
    return is_member(db, hire.customer)
